highlights: 新增每账号独立 HTTP / SOCKS5 代理，支持用户名/密码认证；聊天、生图、视频、额度、会话续签和 VM 唤醒使用账号指定出口。
新增代理连接、出口 IP 与 Muse 会话分层检查；代理故障明确报错，不回退直连，也不误判为 Cookie 失效。
代理设置支持双语管理界面、密码不回显、忙碌账号保护及任务出口快照，旧账号未配置代理时保持原网络行为。
修复 #35：助手先回复“视频已生成”但附件晚到时继续等待真实视频，保留明确拒答快速失败和原总超时。
隔离每个浏览器上下文的下载目录，防止并发下载兜底取错其他账号的成品；上下文创建失败时停止而非回退共享页面。
highlights_en: Added per-account HTTP / SOCKS5 proxies with optional username/password authentication for chat, image/video generation, quota checks, session renewal and VM wake requests.
Added separate proxy reachability, egress IP and Muse-session checks; proxy failures never fall back to a direct connection or imply invalid cookies.
Added bilingual proxy settings, redacted passwords, busy-account protection and task-scoped route snapshots; unconfigured accounts retain their existing network behavior.
Fixed #35: wait for real video attachments after success text arrives, while preserving explicit refusal fast-fail and the existing total deadline.
Isolated browser-context download directories to prevent cross-account fallback results; context creation failures now stop instead of falling back to a shared page.
